ERR_PROJECT_BUSY.message: A project save is already open

ERR_PROJECT_TOO_BIG.message: The project is {len} bytes; at most {max} fit
ERR_PROJECT_TOO_BIG.hint: Remove a part of the project you do not need (devices, actions, program).

ERR_PROJECT_OFFSET.message: The project upload is out of order (at {got}, expected {want})

ERR_PROJECT_INCOMPLETE.message: The project upload is incomplete ({got} of {want} bytes)

ERR_PROJECT_BAD_FRAME.message: The project is broken at byte {offset}

ERR_PROJECT_TRUNCATED.message: The project ends in the middle of a command

ERR_PROJECT_NO_SECTION.message: The project has a command before its first section

ERR_PROJECT_SECTION_FULL.message: The project has more than {max} sections
ERR_PROJECT_SECTION_FULL.hint: Remove a part of the project you do not need.

ERR_PROJECT_SECTION_BIG.hint: Split it: fewer start commands per device, smaller actions.

ERR_PROJECT_ORDER.message: The program must be the last part of the project

ERR_PROJECT_CHUNKS.message: The program is too large to store (more than {max} parts)

ERR_PROJECT_NOT_STORED.hint: Write the project to the board first (toolbar).

ERR_PROJECT_NOT_IN_STREAM.message: A section was sent as a command

ERR_PROJECT_RUN.message: The project is stored, but running it failed

ERR_PROJECT_BAD_ARG.message: A project request is not valid
